entries.draft_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for contacting us. The Roosterly mobile app requires iOS 16 or later, and your iPhone 8 is running iOS 15, which is below that minimum. This is most likely why the app crashes. Please update your iPhone to iOS 16 or later and try again.

Team Roosterly

entries.draft_reply: Goedendag, u kunt het btw-nummer zelf aanpassen onder Instellingen → Bedrijfsgegevens. De wijziging geldt voor toekomstige facturen. Met vriendelijke groet, Team Roosterly
entries.draft_english: Hello, you can change the VAT number yourself under Instellingen (Settings) → Bedrijfsgegevens (Company details). The change applies to future invoices. Kind regards, Team Roosterly
entries.back_translation: Good day, you can change the VAT number yourself under Instellingen → Bedrijfsgegevens. The change applies to future invoices. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

entries.draft_reply:
Hoi, je opent de dienst in de app en tikt op "Ruil aanbieden". Een collega met dezelfde functie kan de ruil dan accepteren. Daarna keurt de manager de ruil goed onder Rooster → Verzoeken. Succes!

Team Roosterly
entries.draft_english:
Hi, you open the shift in the app and tap "Offer swap". A colleague with the same role can then accept the swap. After that the manager approves the swap under Rota → Requests. Good luck!

Team Roosterly
entries.back_translation:
Hi, you open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden". A colleague with the same function can then accept the swap. After that, the manager approves the swap under Rooster → Verzoeken. Good luck!

Team Roosterly
judge_notes: Drafting English says 'Offer swap' while the Dutch button label is 'Ruil aanbieden'; translation keeps the Dutch label and the drafting version does not match it.
Drafting English says 'under Rota → Requests' while the translation keeps 'Rooster → Verzoeken'; the menu names do not match the translation.
Drafting English says 'same role' while translation says 'same function'; wording differs.

entries.draft_reply:
Hallo,

Plus kost €6 per actieve medewerker per maand, exclusief btw. Voor 25 medewerkers komt dat neer op €150 per maand, exclusief btw. Plus bevat onbeperkt aantal vestigingen, API-toegang en de salarisintegraties (Nmbrs, Loket.nl en AFAS). Heeft u nog vragen, dan horen we het graag.

Team Roosterly
entries.draft_english: Hello, Plus costs €6 per active employee per month, excluding VAT. For 25 employees that comes to €150 per month, excluding VAT. Plus includes unlimited locations, API access and the payroll integrations (Nmbrs, Loket.nl and AFAS). If you have any questions, we are happy to hear them. Team Roosterly
entries.back_translation:
Hello,

Plus costs €6 per active employee per month, excluding VAT. For 25 employees, that amounts to €150 per month, excluding VAT. Plus includes an unlimited number of locations, API access, and the salary integrations (Nmbrs, Loket.nl and AFAS). If you have any questions, we would be happy to hear from you.
